guide.text: Arms Warrior raid rotation: keep Rend up, use Colossus Smash on cooldown and pair it with Avatar; Mortal Strike on cooldown, Overpower to build Martial Prowess, Execute below 35% health with Sudden Death procs.
Arms Warrior opener: Charge, Rend, Avatar, Colossus Smash, Mortal Strike, Bladestorm inside the Colossus Smash window, then Overpower and Mortal Strike.
Arms Warrior stat priority: Strength, then Critical Strike, Haste, Mastery and Versatility close together.
Fury Warrior rotation: keep Enrage up with Rampage and Bloodthirst, use Recklessness with Avatar, Raging Blow as filler.
Protection Paladin defensives: keep Shield of the Righteous active on tank-buster casts, Ardent Defender for spikes, Guardian of Ancient Kings for the largest hits.
Holy Paladin healing: Holy Shock on cooldown, Beacon of Light on the active tank, Light of Dawn for group damage, Avenging Wrath for heavy phases.
Holy Priest healing: Prayer of Mending on cooldown, Holy Word: Sanctify for groups, Divine Hymn for raid-wide damage spikes.
Discipline Priest: apply Atonement with Power Word: Radiance before damage, then Penance and Mind Blast to heal through Atonement.
Beast Mastery Hunter rotation: keep Barbed Shot charges rolling to maintain Frenzy, Kill Command on cooldown, Bestial Wrath with Call of the Wild.
Marksmanship Hunter rotation: Aimed Shot with Precise Shots, Rapid Fire on cooldown, Trueshot for burst windows.
Fire Mage Combustion: pool Fire Blast charges, enter Combustion with Pyroblast, chain Hot Streak procs and Phoenix Flames.
Havoc Demon Hunter rotation: Eye Beam on cooldown, Blade Dance when available, Metamorphosis for burst, Immolation Aura for Fury.
Restoration Shaman healing: Riptide on cooldown, Healing Rain stacked, Spirit Link Totem for raid-wide damage, Healing Tide Totem for the heaviest phase.
Arms Warrior Mythic+ rotation: Sweeping Strikes and Cleave on packs, Bladestorm on big pulls, Thunderous Roar with Avatar.
Blood Death Knight defensives: Death Strike after damage, Vampiric Blood and Icebound Fortitude for spikes, Bone Shield stacks above five.

chat.text: User: why did my arms warrior do less damage on ula'tek than kaelis? Agent: Vagxsu lost Colossus Smash uptime during Venom Nova movement; Kaelis kept Combustion inside Bloodlust.
User: what should I change in my opener? Agent: Cast Avatar before Colossus Smash and keep Bladestorm inside the Smash window; you used Bladestorm after Smash ended.
User: who died first on the heroic ula'tek kill? Agent: Fenn died first at 3:12 to Venom Nova, then Tessa at 5:40 to Toxic Pool.
User: was the healing assignment ok on queen ansurek? Agent: Lumi and Tessa carried healing; Orwin was low because he was on dispels during the intermission.
User: why did we wipe on mythic ula'tek pull 3? Agent: Two players stood in Toxic Pool before the first Venom Nova, so the raid lacked damage for the 61% transition.
User: compare Riven and Vagxsu on the mythic kill. Agent: Vagxsu out-damaged Riven by about 11M thanks to Execute; Riven delayed his second Metamorphosis.
User: is my beast mastery hunter gearing right? Agent: Fenn should favour Haste to Critical Strike for Barbed Shot uptime; his Mastery is too high.
User: what kills us on queen ylva normal? Agent: Frost Lance and Glacial Spike do over half the damage taken; spread for Glacial Spike.
User: which defensives should Brakka use on ansurek? Agent: Brakka should save Guardian of Ancient Kings for Royal Condemnation and Ardent Defender for the intermission.
User: and Morrow on blood? Agent: Morrow should keep Bone Shield above five and use Vampiric Blood for the tank buster.
User: holy priest or holy paladin for this tier? Agent: Both are strong; Holy Priest has the better raid cooldown with Divine Hymn, Holy Paladin the stronger tank healing.
User: what about disc? Agent: Discipline is fine if the raid can plan Atonement windows before damage; it is weaker on random damage.
User: best arms warrior stats? Agent: Strength first, then Critical Strike; Haste, Mastery and Versatility are close.
User: and for mythic plus? Agent: In Mythic+ Arms leans on Sweeping Strikes and Bladestorm for packs; Haste helps with more Bladestorms.
User: how was Kaelis's combustion on ansurek? Agent: Kaelis died at 7:02 to Royal Condemnation, so his second Combustion was lost.
